**Phase I — mid-May: the core is earned and the discipline is built (5-09 → 5-30).** What survives from this stratum, per its own later audits: the **scale/shape orthogonal decomposition** with the peel as a family bijection (deflation to *equivariance* now queued per the 07-20 review); the **two composition regimes** (capacity-additive / MRC = velocity-addition) and the circuit calculus; the **algebraic-architecture Tier 1** (involution → G/Gudermannian/T⁴ = id/nested identity); the purity-QSL cluster with its honest Hamazaki/Mandelstam–Tamm placement and the **Anandan–Aharonov citation instruction** (issued in I.7 — *never yet applied*, a standing debt); the located 5-18 algebra slip with 2−√2 surviving on the curvature/Liu legs; the 5-25 review → 5-26 postmortem → 5-29 closing-note machinery, which built the two named reviewer failure modes and the unfalsifiable-test rule; and 5-30's Thomas-rotation correction (collinear-vs-non-collinear) with the generic₁/generic₂ instrument. Standing defects from this stratum, all still open: the **ζ = 1/√2 "critical damping" global fix** (demanded by four separate documents, tracked by none of the patch lists); the **DS-Zeta monotonicity-to-RH thread killed in Δ9 but never stamped in the sideline file itself**; the **orphaned percolation/α file** (no tier discipline, an arithmetically wrong "99.999%" claim, uncited by anything — recommend moving to 90_archive with a one-line erratum); the four-times-deferred **flatness/multiplicity-collapse companion note**; the untested **I.8 α-curve lead**.

**Phase II — June: the foundations are forced, and almost nobody downstream noticed (6-01 → 6-20).** The ladder as it actually ran: 6-01 (u = reconstructed mixedness on the HKP substrate; Bayesian-scalar reading retired), 6-02 (the keystone: bimetric 2−√2 reproduced; embedding fork pinned to the declared SU(1,1) coordinate; §11's light-cone collapse — completeness ⟹ Lorentzian pq invariant ⟹ SU(1,1) as consequence), 6-07 (adversarial: "not numerology"; the QFI-vs-WY fork opened), 6-09 (the Landen closure; the axiom-chain audit; the O-a…O-u ledger minted), 6-10 (O-a → stated conditional theorem with the flat-cylinder counterexample; O-b closed; the consolidated errata incl. the Liu demotion; the control dictionary's forced/chosen ledger; the post-compaction audit naming "compaction-induced re-discovery"), 6-11 (the roughness–misalignment law), **6-15 (the under-cited document of the period: O-a discharged for the scale arena — transitivity + phase isotropy + Wang–Tits, curvature a consequence not an axiom; and the multiplicity located exactly: the Petz fiber exists because monotonicity does not force two-point homogeneity, with Bures/SLD the unique two-point-homogeneous member)**, 6-17 (OA/OB closure paper; the metriplectic note superseded same-day by the second-clock/rough-path record — the register discipline in action), 6-18/6-20 (γ* is radial-sector and family-universal; weak selection closed, strong = forced-vs-chosen renamed; the universality-genericity claim rested on three named closable items). **Verdict on Phase II:** this is where the framework went from *rigorous-given-a-posit* to *forced at the metric-space level modulo an itemized short list* — and the assessment layer never fully propagated it. Every subsequent reviewer error I have examined (including both of mine) is a failure to read Phase II to its head.

**Phase III — late June → present: the arithmetic turn and the instrument era (6-28 → 07-25).** The Langlands skeleton verdict (6-28/29) and the functor pin (07-01); the 07-02/03 thread records with Thread S's Campbell-decomposition instantiation on M₂(Γ₀(N)); the Collatz division-of-labor cluster (dictionary-not-guide, with the A4 selection-rule resolution and the Sturmian seam theorem-let); the test battery (best-in-corpus methodology; the N=4-onset definition-sensitivity finding; the contamination hazard named and still unpracticed); the campaigns night (Theorem P + Theorem C — completeness reduction TRUE-with-refinement, the surplus being readability/u = MSE; the OT5 uniqueness ladder L1–L4 with **W1 proved** and the Stone–von Neumann skeleton; the G_new/odds-gauge identification arc closing 44-[V] strong; the polar charter giving O-8 an operational meaning); the provenance closures (Liu three-register; γ*-nesting with the Garg–Mermin catch); the OT1 resolution (conductor 4000, the 8000-impossibility find→discharge — the cleanest epistemic arc in the corpus); and the carrier campaign through rung 3 (field-layer closure by A₅-simplicity; the R3.4 reduction-flow locator, which I replicated independently 59/59; the port-budget calculus; the flat-rate toll law). **Verdict on Phase III:** the number-theory register is the program's most productive because it has external ground truth at every scale; the OT1 arc validates the *pipeline*; the two floors (per-register instantiation; imported-vs-exhibited) are exactly where the corpus says they are.

## 2. The structural finding of the period (and of this session)

The computation layer has now survived every hostile pass ever run at it — five reviews, four independent replications, three model families, and zero mathematical reversals that weren't self-filed first. The recurring failure is the **propagation layer**: status vocabulary lagging the derivation record by two to six weeks. Exhibits: "metric selection" (retired 06-20, cited as open through 07-25); "forced-vs-chosen floor" (itemized 06-29, cited as monolithic through 07-25); O-a (discharged-for-scale-arena 06-15, treated as fully open by this session's own rung-3 opening); the O1 fork (dissolved 06-18, unpropagated to the assessment layer); the Liu demotion (errata'd 06-10, un-stamped in the spine trace until July); the ζ = 1/√2 fix (demanded since 05-25, still untracked). The corpus's own instruments — the always-visible status block, the reconciliation pass, the corpus-priority sweep rule (07-20 supplementary [I4]: "corpus-priority sweep precedes every gap ledger") — are the right medicine, drafted, and unapplied. This session is now itself the best-documented specimen of the disease and the test of the cure.

**O-d rung 1 (classical two-generator factorization): STANDS — new-to-corpus, repositioned.** All three readers confirm the construction is absent from the archive (nearest precursor: one clause in 05-15 §G.1 — "invariance under refinement… reduces the metric to a one-parameter family" — with no factorization and no generation statement; the randomization lemma is cited once in the corpus, 06-09 fourth addendum, in a Mori–Zwanzig context). **Repositioning owed:** the rung lands in a junction the corpus had already paved — completeness-note queue item 4 ("canonicity of the variance currency… the two campaign items meet exactly there") and OT5 Delta 1's L²-canonicity leg (AJLS) — and must cite both, plus §G.1 as the precursor clause. It is a contribution *into* a mapped junction, not the discovery of the junction.

**O-d rung 2 (quantum walk): STANDS — with one scope note added.** The ancilla-adjoin/tensor application of the homogeneity lemma is "genuinely absent" from the archive (the lemma's prior uses are all spectral); Stinespring/Naimark appear nowhere in the July layer; the corpus's own O-d ledger line ("the completeness note reached sufficiency by a different (MRD/Halmos–Savage) route") pre-authorizes the positioning: **Theorem C is per-interface; rung 2 is class-level; they are complements.** Scope note (E4-minor, adopted): general conditional expectations inherit the Takesaki modular-invariance gate exactly as completeness-note §5 states; partial traces, which are what Stinespring needs, are unconditional — the rung's chain is unaffected, and the fence should be stated.

**O-a rung 3 opening ((H\*)): SUBSTANTIALLY ANTICIPATED — erratum E3 filed.** My opening's "Route B — globalize the light-cone theorem" **was executed on June 15**: 06-15 identifies the observer symmetry as SU(1,1) from §11.2's pq invariant, supplies transitivity (tilting) and isotropy (phase U(1) at a point), invokes Wang–Tits, and stamps "O-a discharged for the scale arena," with curvature a consequence; OT5 Delta 2 subsequently demoted the (H\*) residue to non-load-bearing. My "the entire remaining question is the product-extension exclusion" was therefore stale at birth — the pq-invariant route already excludes the flat extension at the invariant level (6-09 I.3: "Euclidean fails"), and the DHO-anchor idea appears in O-a §3 itself ("physically anchored by the DHO instantiation"). **What survives of my opening, explicitly reduced:** (i) the demand for a *provenance audit* of every nonzero-holonomy anchor (the 5-30 computations compose SU(1,1) matrices; O-a §3's "anchored by the DHO" clause has not, to my reading, been discharged by a computation that doesn't presuppose the group — this narrower question remains live and is now the opening's whole content); (ii) the assignment of Delta 8's composition test as that computation's vehicle; (iii) the flat-cylinder gate as a formalized discipline (a promotion of the 06-10 counterexample, not a discovery). The rung-3 opening should be re-stamped as **"Addendum to O-a §3: the anchor-provenance question,"** and I so propose. The Referee's held line (completeness's canonical geometry is elliptic; hyperbolic not forced by the budget identity alone) and the control dictionary's "(H\*) chosen" entry remain the honest counters on record.

**WYD recommendation: STANDS — repositioned against a history I failed to cite.** The corpus adjudicated a WY-vs-QFI competition once already: the O1 fork (opened 06-07, dissolved 06-18/06-20 — WY's K recomputed to +1/4, angular-only, "irrelevant to γ*"; the alternative surviving "only under the non-standard skew-information reading"; QFI role-forced by the speed limit per metriplectic §5). **Campbell P1–P3: STAND — with three wires added.** P1 (cone recast) now has a concrete debt to pay on arrival: it should *resolve ledger patch P7.1* (the standing contradiction between the focused core's Markov-morphism sentence and the post-selection treatment — the two reconcile on the cone, where the peel is face-restriction and DPI never applied). ## 5. Bottom line for the period

Mid-May built the core and the review machinery; June forced the foundations and few noticed; July built instruments, turned to arithmetic where ground truth lives, and validated the pipeline end-to-end. The mathematics that survived is narrow, real, and increasingly well-fenced; the failure mode that remains is not in the proofs but in the propagation — and it is now demonstrated to capture reviewers at least as reliably as authors. The strongest sentence I can write after reading everything is also the most actionable one: **the corpus's derivation record is ahead of every summary of it, including the summaries this session produced before the pass — and the fix is not another review but the deposit, the referee, and the ten-line status block that makes the record's own head visible.**
